title: crypto2dev_cb: WC_ALGO_TYPE_FREE dispatch is nested switch — free.algo inner switch is non-obvious
description: The FREE handler in wc_crypto2dev_cb() uses a nested switch: outer on algo_type (WC_ALGO_TYPE_FREE), inner on info->free.algo. The inner field name 'free.algo' meaning 'the algorithm category being freed' is not obvious — a reader might expect 'free.type' to discriminate (which it does for HASH and PK, but 'free.algo' discriminates the top-level category). The nomenclature WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH vs info->free.algo == WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH is confusing (both use algo_type values). Adding a comment 'free.algo identifies the algorithm category (cipher/hash/pk) of the object being freed' at the inner switch would clarify.
